reference_items.figure_description:
The stem shows a 3-D triangular prism resting horizontally on one rectangular face, with dashed lines indicating the three hidden edges. The options show four candidate nets:
- Option A: A central horizontal rectangle with an isosceles triangle attached to each vertical side, and another rectangle attached to the outer edge of each triangle angled upward, forming an open V-shape.
- Option B: Three congruent rectangles stacked vertically in a column, with two identical triangles attached to the right edges of the top and middle rectangles, both pointing right.
- Option C: Two congruent rectangles stacked vertically, each having a triangle attached to its left edge pointing left; a third rectangle extends to the right from the top rectangle, ending with a triangle pointing right.
- Option D: Three congruent rectangles stacked vertically in a column, with one triangle attached to the right edge of the top rectangle pointing right, and another triangle attached to the left edge of the bottom rectangle pointing left.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 1999 and 2003 eighth-grade mathematics data.

The overall block is 5 cubes wide along the front, 4 cubes deep along the right side, and 3 cubes tall. In the center of the top face, there is a rectangular rectangular hole measuring 3 cubes wide by 2 cubes deep, bordered by a rim that is 1 cube wide on all four sides. The hole extends vertically straight down through the entire height of 3 cubes.

reference_items.figure_description:
The stem shows a net of a cube consisting of six square faces arranged in a cross. A vertical column of four squares has, from top to bottom: a square containing a solid black circle, a square containing an unfilled circle, a square containing a solid black triangle pointing upward, and a blank square. Flanking the second square (with the unfilled circle) are two additional blank squares, one to the left and one to the right.

The options show perspective views of a cube displaying three faces (top, front-left, and front-right):
- A: Top face has a solid black circle, front-left face has an upward-pointing black triangle, and front-right face has an unfilled circle.
- B: Top face has an unfilled circle, front-left face has an upward-pointing black triangle, and front-right face has a solid black circle.
- C: Top face has an unfilled circle, front-left face has a solid black circle, and front-right face is blank.
- D: Top face has an unfilled circle, front-left face is blank, and front-right face is blank.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the two-parameter logistic (2PL) model, which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 1 point, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.
